svg.text: Every region missed plan; Southwest carries the largest gap
Revenue against the Q3 target, $ by region
Southwest and Central, the two weakest, hold the
two largest targets: 10.0M of the 23.3M plan.
Attainment ranged from 67.2% (South) to 48.6% (Central); no region reached 70% of its target.
svg.desc: Region by region against plan. Southwest has the biggest gap at $2.79M and the lowest attainment at 49.4%; Central is next at $2.32M. South has the smallest gap simply because its target was the lowest, at $3.8M. Southwest and Central together carry $10.0M of the $23.3M plan, which is why the portfolio miss is concentrated there.
